title: mcp-commands configuration file
description: Operational settings for mcp-commands, applied when the file is passed via --config. CLI flags take precedence over values in this file; environment variables do as well, except that a present server.allowed-origins or allow-all-origins key takes precedence over its environment variable. A present key counts as explicitly set.

$schema.description: Editor support only (e.g. the URL of this schema for editor validation); ignored by mcp-commands

watch.description: Watch for tool changes: hot-reload in server mode, live re-print with --list-tools (flag: --watch)

log-level.description: Minimum log level: trace, debug, info, warn, or error (flag: --log-level)

timeout.description: Global per-tool timeout as a formatted duration (e.g. "5m", "1h 30m 5s") or NONE (flag: --timeout)

server.description: HTTP server settings. Ignored (silently) in diagnostic modes (--list-tools / --call-tool).

host.description: IP address for the HTTP server (flag: --host)

port.description: Port for the HTTP server; 0 selects stdio mode, must be 1..65535 (flag: --port)

api-key.description: API token for HTTP mode (flag: --api-key; precedence: flag > --api-key-file > MCP_COMMANDS_API_KEY > this key)

api-key-file.description: Read the API token from a file (flag: --api-key-file; content is trimmed, trailing newline ok)

tls-cert.description: TLS certificate file for HTTP mode (PEM); requires a key (flag: --tls-cert)

tls-key.description: TLS key file for HTTP mode (PEM); requires a certificate (flag: --tls-key)

insecure-no-auth.description: Allow an unauthenticated HTTP server on a non-loopback host (loudly warned; never use in production) (flag: --insecure-no-auth)

max-concurrent.description: Maximum concurrent tool executions; 0 for default, must be 1..256 (flag: --max-concurrent)

allowed-origins.description: Exact origin allowlist for CORS (flag: --allowed-origins); an explicit empty array disables the allowlist and suppresses MCP_COMMANDS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

allow-all-origins.description: Echo any Origin header for CORS, dev convenience (flag: --allow-all-origins); an explicit false suppresses MCP_COMMANDS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS

disable-localhost-protection.description: Disable the SDK's DNS-rebinding protection for loopback servers (flag: --disable-localhost-protection)
